cohort: A 24-year-old woman with a twin pregnancy diagnosed with Listeria monocytogenes infection.
finding: Listeria monocytogenes infection in twin pregnancy can lead to severe maternal complications and fetal death, but timely intervention with antibiotics and comprehensive management can lead to maternal recovery.
mod_finding: An emergent cesarean delivery was performed to deliver one alive and one dead fetus, followed by an urgent exploratory laparotomy to manage postpartum hemorrhage.
